title: CollabCode IDE
description: A real-time collaborative coding environment. Uses WebSockets for instant synchronization and Docker containers for safe, ephemeral code execution.

title: QR Hunt
description: A full-stack treasure hunt game built for college fests. Features live leaderboards using Firestore, JWT authentication, and dynamic QR code validation.

title: EchoSphere
description: High-performance mock API generator. Allows frontend devs to define JSON schemas and receive instant, rate-limited REST endpoints for testing.

title: TOTP Generator
description: A secure, ephemeral vault for storing TOTP secrets. Implements time-based one-time passwords with encryption and auto-deletion features for enhanced security.

title: TinyURL
description: Scalable URL shortening service. Engineered for high-read throughput with caching strategies and analytics tracking for click events.

title: Mount Mate
description: A developer utility tool that generates JSON file system structures for WebContainers, streamlining the setup of browser-based node environments.
